I have implemented [`run_tasks`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-2t5f2vf_/run.py#L7-L68) in [run.py](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-2t5f2vf_/run.py) (mounted at `/app/run.py` inside the container).

### Overview of Implementation
- **Concurrency Control**: Uses `asyncio.Semaphore(max_concurrent)` so at most `max_concurrent` tasks execute simultaneously, and pending tasks that haven't acquired the semaphore yet are never started if a cancellation occurs.
- **Graceful Cleanup on Interrupt/Cancellation**:
  - When `asyncio.gather` is interrupted (either via `asyncio.run`'s SIGINT cancellation, direct task cancellation, or an exception), [`run_tasks`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-2t5f2vf_/run.py#L7-L68) cancels any non-cancelling child tasks and awaits `asyncio.gather(*running_tasks, return_exceptions=True)` before re-raising so that asynchronous `finally` / `except asyncio.CancelledError` blocks in running tasks finish executing before the event loop closes.
  - Also installs a fallback `SIGINT` handler when run outside `asyncio.run` (e.g., via `loop.run_until_complete`) to convert `SIGINT` into task cancellation and cleanly await task finalization before raising `KeyboardInterrupt`.
